description: Find listings by describing what you want in everyday language, such as returned kitchen appliances in bulk. No sign-in required. Each match includes a similarity score from 0 to 1. The closest listings are returned even when none is a strong match. If meaning search finds nothing, the same words are searched as keywords. category, when set, is one catalogue category such as electronics. max_price is the maximum unit price in cents.

category.description: Restrict candidates to a single category

condition.description: Condition of the goods: salvage (sold as-is), customer returns, shelf pulls, overstock, or new or refurbished.

limit.description: Number of ranked results to return

max_price.description: Maximum price per unit in cents

query.description: Natural-language description of what the buyer wants

name: search_inventory_semantic
title: Semantic inventory search
